policy: Only player/client-visible stock MajorMUD behavior receives Classic parity credit. Raw imported binaries remain local-only.

break_native.visible_branch_order: At 0x004143D2 native checks _is_inside_autocombat; if true it calls _display_autocombat_broken(user,1) at 0x004143E6, then calls _kill_autocombat(user,1) at 0x004143F8.
break_native.help: Combat help: Break - Will break off autocombat. Magic help: Break - Will break off casting of auto-combat spells.
break_native.reforged_0351: Active manual BREAK now enqueues the exact player line and High-priority room observer line before live combat teardown.
break_native.remaining_boundary: Reforged simplified PvP currently terminates the shared encounter for both participants. Native _kill_autocombat is per-user; exact opponent-side PvP autocombat ownership remains unresolved, so commands.break-autocombat remains STRONG.

stock_extension_absence.trade_finding: Stock MajorMUD player transfer is GIVE; AUCTION is a communication channel. No native accept/cancel TRADE escrow command is present in the original command-export census.
stock_extension_absence.repair_finding: No _cmd_repair exists and none of 204 decoded Classic services projects a repair owner. Reforged durability REPAIR therefore remains non-Classic only.

pass28_strings: Stopped sending break before combat while sneaking, except when punching
megamud.help: Break Combat Before Running states that MegaMUD issues a break command before attempting to run from PVP/monsters when already in combat mode.
megamud.compatibility: BREAK remains ordinary stock terminal input/output; no MegaMUD-specific protocol or private client-data dependency is introduced.

borin.parser: Apps/Source/Reforged.App/Services/ClassicGameplayLineParser.cs already treats lines beginning *Combat Off* as the authoritative combat-disengaged marker.
borin.compatibility: No Borin-specific command rewrite is required; the corrected server emits the native marker Borin already consumes.
